cases.case_label: XDP SVA_F in TAF1 intron 32 (reverse orientation; humanized mouse model)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 78-kb XDP patient-derived TAF1 segment carrying the intron 32 SVA_F was written into mouse Taf1; the SVA is actively transcribed and acts as an elongation barrier, causing premature termination of TAF1 transcription at intron 32 (cryptic splice acceptor/polyA), reduced TAF1, TATA-gene downregulation, apoptosis, and striatal atrophy in male mice.
cases.quote: Proposed model: transcription of SVA_F, and to a lesser extent, SVA_D, causes premature termination of TAF1 transcription at intron 32.
